t_advice_summary_textbox.text: keep an eye on the colour of the knomes because that way you can figure out how to get more mushrooms  but it can switch up

vb_textbox.text: try to keep to the right hand side knome at the start and if it gives you lots of mushrooms follow that colour until it gives you low mushrooms. you will see a pattern of which coloured knomes give the most mushrooms just try to follow it. also make sure you tap your space bar a couple of times when you collect your mushrooms to make sure that it registers it.
